title: Comorbidity between depression and anxiety: assessing the role of bridge mental states in dynamic psychological networks
limitations: - Sample may not be representative of the general population; - Group-level analyses may not capture individual differences; - Limited temporal resolution of data; - Potential confounding by unmeasured variables.
notes: The paper was preregistered on OSF. Code and data are available upon request via the NESDA Data Access Committee, but not publicly available in a repository.
